provider: Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) / PLATEAU experimental catalogue

request_contract.parameter_rules: DOCUMENTATION ONLY; NO live GraphQL POST is authorized. Future separate rights-reviewed call would have a single fixed read-only GraphQL operation: query OcShinjuku2024 { citygmlDatasets(input: {cityCodes: ["13104"], years: [2024]}) { id cityCode prefectureCode year registrationYear url compositeUrl featureTypes metadataZipUrls } }. Require exact submitted query identity, exact municipality/year, no variables, arbitrary fields, aliases, introspection, mutations, pagination, retries, dynamic query injection, credentialed access or ZIP URL following. Provider schema is experimental and may change. An offline synthetic response preflight is available; this is not a request runner.

response_contract.format: GraphQL JSON data.citygmlDatasets containing exactly our nine-field, fixed city/year query selection: id, cityCode, prefectureCode, year, registrationYear, url, compositeUrl, featureTypes, metadataZipUrls. The query deliberately DOES NOT SELECT optional fileSize because the provider's schema reference and CityGML guide disagree about its availability. Response fields not selected in this fixed query are rejected by the offline preflight; GraphQL provider errors fail closed.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Exact Shinjuku 2024 metadata is a release candidate only. GraphQL native ID is independent of municipality code; prefectureCode must be 13. The PLATEAU CityGML guide advertises optional CMS ZIP size via GraphQL fileSize, whereas the current static GraphQL schema reference display omits it; therefore the minimal fixed query omits that disputed field and reports CMS size as unknown. The separate REST catalogue documents optional row-level file_size, and nested G-Spatial archive file_size is NOT the CMS source ZIP. compositeUrl pins year, not immutable bytes or publication rights; buildings are not insured assets.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: GraphQL query complexity limits and response size apply. If separately authorized, enforce an exact static query body, fixed host/DNS and response-size cap before parsing; do not use this T0 contract as request permission.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Experimental schema is subject to changes without notice or SLA. Pin query bytes/code SHA and response bytes SHA-256, UTC, fiscal-year record and CMS original identity in a separately reviewed T1 receipt; do not equate stable redirect URL with immutable original bytes.

rights_and_policy.notes: Public technical API documentation and general PLATEAU open-data principles do not establish endpoint-specific automation rights or municipality/version-level source redistribution. This contract records a potential bounded metadata query only. No model/data/raw distribution permission is conferred.

notes: Source docs reviewed 2026-11-01: live GraphQL schema reference display and CityGML guide disagree on optional fileSize. Exact nine-field query deliberately selects only mutually documented fields; static GraphQL query neither executes nor asserts that the provider lacks other fields. The parser rejects extra fields in its OWN fixed selection, not as invalid GraphQL schema fields. No source bytes, HTTP POST, commercial rights or CAT model inputs.
